label: Sale deed (immovable property)

review.note: Fixed clauses are a plain sale deed. A sale deed transfers title, so it must be reviewed by an advocate against the title documents before use.

notes: A sale of immovable property of value ₹100 or more can be made only by a registered instrument (Section 54, Transfer of Property Act, 1882). Register this deed with the Sub-Registrar.
Stamp duty and registration fees vary by state and by property value. Check the guideline value before signing.
Describe the property exactly as in the title documents. This tool cannot check the title or look for encumbrances.

slots.label: Seller's father's or husband's name, with the relation

Description of the property (survey number, extent, boundaries)
slots.example: Plot No. 12, Survey No. 45/2, Ganapathy Village, Coimbatore Taluk, measuring 2,400 sq. ft. Bounded: North by Road; South by Plot 13; East by Plot 11; West by Park.

slots.label: How did the seller get the property? (document, date, registration number)
slots.example: By sale deed dated 4 March 2012, registered as Document No. 812/2012 at the Sub-Registrar Office, Coimbatore.

slots.example: ₹5,00,000 by RTGS on 10 August 2026 as advance and the balance by demand draft no. 123456 dated 1 September 2026.

blocks.text: This Sale Deed is made at {{place}} on {{deed_date|date}} between {{seller_name}}, {{seller_parentage}}, residing at {{seller_address}} (the "Vendor"), and {{buyer_name}}, {{buyer_parentage}}, residing at {{buyer_address}} (the "Purchaser").
The Vendor is the owner of the property described in the Schedule below (the "Property"). The Vendor acquired the Property as follows: {{title_source}}
The Vendor has agreed to sell, and the Purchaser has agreed to buy, the Property for {{sale_price|inr}} ({{sale_price|words}}) (the "Sale Price").
NOW THIS DEED WITNESSES AS FOLLOWS
Payment. The Sale Price has been paid by the Purchaser to the Vendor as follows: {{payment_details}} The Vendor acknowledges receipt of the full Sale Price.
Transfer. In consideration of the Sale Price, the Vendor sells, transfers and conveys the Property to the Purchaser absolutely and forever, together with all rights attached to it.
Title and encumbrances. The Vendor states that the Vendor has the right to sell the Property. Mortgages, liens, litigation or claims on the Property, if any: {{encumbrances}}.
Possession. The Vendor has handed over vacant and peaceful possession of the Property to the Purchaser on the date of this Deed.
Further assurance. The Vendor shall, at the Purchaser's cost, sign any further document reasonably needed to give effect to this Deed.
The Vendor and the Purchaser have signed this Deed on the date first written above, in the presence of the witnesses named below.
